speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] My name is Sprocket, and I have lived in this scrapyard my whole life.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Every year, the goblins hold a marble racing season called the Heavy Metal GP.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Ten goblin drivers each steer a marble down a giant track full of traps.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] The season visits six different tracks, and the best driver overall is champion.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] I built my own racing marble out of an old ball bearing and a bolt.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] All I need now is a racing team that will let me drive it.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] Hey! You are the kid who keeps climbing over my fence to watch the races.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] I am Zapp Gutwrench, the mechanic for Apex Racing, the team next door.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] Apex Racing? Is it true that your best driver disappeared last season?

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [angry] It is true. They missed the last race, and nobody has heard from them since.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [sighs] Now Apex has an empty seat, no money, and a new season starting this week.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Then give that seat to me. I work cheap, and my marble really does roll.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [smug] All right, kid, I will give you one chance. Listen carefully.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] Each track in the season hosts three races in a row, and you drive in all three.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] If you finish all three races at the first track, the Apex seat is yours.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Where is the first track, and what is it like?

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] It is called Marblehurst, and it is the track where every season begins.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] It has a little bit of everything, so it is a fair test for a new driver.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [angry] Steer left and right to choose your path, and try not to bounce off the walls.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [smug] Grab the item crates on the way down, because items can win you a race.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Steer, grab crates, and do not hit walls. That sounds easy enough to me.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [smug] Every new driver says that before Marblehurst. Very few say it afterwards.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] Did Apex Racing really hire a goblin who smells like a rusty bucket?

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [angry] Ignore him, kid. That is Ace Spadegrin, the champion from last season.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] I have won the championship twice, and you are driving a bolt with ideas.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Be nice, Ace. Every champion was a nobody once, even you.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] Zapp, who is the lady in the fancy hat?

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [sighs] That is Duchess Vex. She owns a rival team and lends money to half the drivers.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] I always notice new drivers, Sprocket. They are so easy to put a price on.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [angry] Enjoy the start line, rookie, because you will not see me again after it.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [angry] Get out of my way, scrapyard goblin, this is my racing line!

speaker: big-grubba
text: [cheerful] I am Big Grubba, and I always squash the new drivers!

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [gasps] A marble made from a ball bearing and a bolt just beat me at Marblehurst?

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [surprised] How interesting. The little scrapyard goblin can actually race.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] You finished all three races and came out on top, kid. The Apex seat is yours.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [angry] Enjoy it while it lasts, rookie. The next track is full of walls.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] I finished in the top three at my very first track!

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] Third place is where scrap belongs, so do not get too excited.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] A top three finish on your first try is great. The Apex seat is yours.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] People with money will start asking about you now, Sprocket.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] I think I bounced off every single wall in Marblehurst.

speaker: red-morrigan
text: [surprised] I am Red Morrigan, rookie. Everybody has a bad first race. Mine caught fire.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [sighs] You still finished all three races, and that was our deal. The seat is yours.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] Keep that seat warm, rookie, until Apex finds a real driver.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] Our next track is Monte Pipo, which runs through the streets of a harbour town.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [angry] The streets are narrow and the corners are tight, so passing people is hard.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Then I will get in front at the start and stay there the whole way.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] You need a proper teacher, kid, and I know an old goblin who can help.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] Zapp, there is an old goblin asleep in the shed behind our garage.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] I am not asleep. I am thinking with my eyes closed, which is different.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] Sprocket, this is Old Smokey. He raced in the very first Heavy Metal GP.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] I raced in it and I lost it. I have fixed marbles in this shed ever since.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Will you teach me how to race? I have never driven on a street track before.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] Here is your first lesson. Do you see the orange pegs sticking out of the track?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] Every orange peg you hit gives you credits, and credits buy you items.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] Most new drivers ignore the pegs. Good drivers bounce off as many as they can.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] Hit ten orange pegs in a single race at Monte Pipo, and I will teach you more.

speaker: red-morrigan
text: [angry] A narrow street track and a rookie with a bent marble. This will be fun to watch.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] I do not think we have met. Who are you?

speaker: red-morrigan
text: [cheerful] I am Red Morrigan. Remember my braid, because you will watch it pass you.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Hello again, Sprocket. I started keeping a file on you, but it is very thin.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] It is thin because I only just started racing.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] No, darling. It is thin because nobody has bought you yet.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [angry] You only beat me at Marblehurst because my marble had a loose bolt.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Of course it did, champion. I am sure that is exactly what happened.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] Say that again at the finish line, if you somehow get there before me.

speaker: the-hood
text: [firmly] You will not reach the finish line ahead of me, rookie.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] Who is that driver in the hood? I never saw their face at the start.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Hit the orange pegs, kid! Every single one of them is worth credits!

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] You won at Monte Pipo. Your steering was messy, but you went after the pegs.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Were you actually counting how many pegs I hit?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] I have counted pegs in every race since my first season. It is an old habit.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [angry] Who taught that scrapyard goblin how to race like that?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] A top three finish at Monte Pipo. Most new drivers leave that town in pieces.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Does that mean I passed your lesson?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] It means you are close. In my shed, being close is worth a lot.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] The walls at Monte Pipo do not move. I checked many times, with my marble.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Good. Now you know where those walls are. Most drivers take a year to learn that.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] I hit that same corner in my first season. I still remember the sound it made.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] The pit lane is so quiet at night, once all the races are over.

speaker: the-hood
text: [firmly] You steer your marble just like someone I used to know.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] You are the driver in the hood from today. Who are you?

speaker: the-hood
text: [smug] Nobody you need to worry about yet. Keep an eye on your bolts, rookie.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] Wait! Who do I drive like? Please tell me.

speaker: the-hood
text: [frustrated] Ask Old Smokey why he never talks about the old mine under the last track.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] Our third track is Silverpeg, and it is the best place in the season to train.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Why is Silverpeg so good for training?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] It is packed with the three things that beat new drivers: walls, loops and hoops.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] Some walls have cracks in them, and a hard enough hit smashes a shortcut open.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] The loops spin your marble in a full circle, if you are fast enough.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] The fire hoops launch you through the air, if you aim for the middle.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Smash one wall, finish one loop, and fly through three hoops in a single race.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] Do all of that, and you will have learned what took me ten years.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] You have nobody to teach you? Fine, then I will teach you, but I am not good at it.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [smug] Our next track is Silverpeg. Smash the cracked walls, finish the loops, hit the hoops.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Wall lesson. A cracked wall is a door, but only a hard hit will open it.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] My marble is tiny and light. How am I supposed to hit anything hard?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] If you cannot be heavy, then be fast. Speed hits just as hard as weight.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] Loop lesson. You win or lose a loop before you even reach it.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] So I need to build up my speed on the way into the loop?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Exactly. Arrive slow and you will just rock back and forth at the bottom.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] Hoop lesson. A fire hoop throws you forward, so steer for the middle of it.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] And I need to get through three of them in one race.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] Three in one race. Miss the middle and you will come out a little toasted.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] You hit ten pegs at Monte Pipo, which means you listen. That is rarer than talent.

speaker: knuckles-blau
text: [angry] I am Knuckles Blau, old goblin, and your rookie keeps driving into my way!

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] A cracked wall is coming up, kid! Hit it as fast as you can!

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] Steer for the middle of the hoop, not the fire around it!

speaker: old-smokey
text: [gasps] You won at Silverpeg and passed all three lessons, all in one visit.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] That is because you are a good teacher.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] I taught one other goblin this way once. They won everything, and then they left.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] Where did they go?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Never mind that. We race at Spa next, and you must not sign anything there.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] A top three finish and a smashed wall. That was skill, kid, not luck.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Spa is next, and everyone says it is the fastest track of the season.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] It is fast, and so are the people who work there. Do not sign anything at Spa.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] I came into the loop too slowly and just rocked back and forth at the bottom.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] At least you know why it happened now, and that is real progress.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Spa is next. Bring all the speed you have, and do not sign anything there.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] Kid, Duchess Vex wants to meet you in her private office at Spa.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Of course it is Vex. It is always Vex.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] What would a rich duchess want with a goblin from a scrapyard?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] She wants to own you, kid. Owning drivers is how she wins races.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Sit down, Sprocket. That chair cost more than your whole scrapyard.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] It is the softest chair I have ever sat in.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] Join my team, and I will give you a new marble and the best mechanics money buys.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] That sounds amazing. What do I have to give you in return?

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Twice a season, I tell you where to finish a race, and you finish exactly there.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] You want me to lose races on purpose?

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] Apex Racing is broke, child. They cannot pay your race fees for much longer.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Somebody always ends up paying for a driver. It might as well be me.

speaker: scorch
text: [cheerful] I am Scorch, and welcome to Spa, the fastest track of the whole season!

speaker: scorch
text: [cheerful] It is full of slippery ice slides and boost pads, so somebody always crashes.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] From what I hear, the one who crashes is usually you.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [angry] Rookie, I saw you leave Vex's office. Whatever she offered, it was not a gift.

speaker: the-hood
text: [firmly] Nothing that woman offers is ever free.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] The driver in the hood again. Do you race for Vex?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] You passed the wall, the loop and the hoops at Silverpeg. I am proud of you, kid.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Spa is long and fast. If anything on your marble feels loose, trust that feeling.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] My item just broke when I tried to use it! Something on my marble is loose!

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] I cannot fix it from here, kid! Just keep steering and stay on the track!

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] A win for my team already. You see? We are a perfect match, you and I.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] All I see is a contract and a very soft chair.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Remember our deal. Twice this season, you will finish where I tell you.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [gasps] You said no to Vex and still won at Spa. That was either brave or very stupid.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] It was probably both. Scrapyard goblins are like that.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] Enjoy your trophy, Sprocket. Nobody says no to me twice.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Second or third place. Both of those positions are very useful to me.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] Is that what I sold you when I signed? My finishing positions?

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] You sold me nothing, darling. I bought you a future, and you pay for it in races.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] A top three finish at Spa, on a marble nobody paid for. That one is truly yours.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] And I do not owe anybody a single race for it.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] Not yet, child. Not yet.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] You crashed while driving for my team. Do you know how much that costs me?

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] It cost me my marble, mostly.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Then get it fixed quickly. I need you racing at the next track, Suzuka.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] Something on my marble broke halfway down the track, and then I hit the wall.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [surprised] You say no to Vex, and then your marble falls apart. That is very convenient.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] Convenient for who? Are you saying somebody did this to me on purpose?

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] After the last race, my marble crashed and broke into three pieces.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Look at this bolt. It did not wear out. Somebody cut it with a saw.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] I ran onto the track to pull you out of the wreck, kid. I think my arm is broken.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [gasps] I checked that bolt myself before the race, kid! I swear I checked it!

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] Smokey is lying on the ground hurt, and you are the one holding a wrench.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Your item launcher is burnt from the inside. Somebody tampered with it.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] Somebody would really cheat like that, in the middle of a race?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] In this sport, yes, they would. Now you know what racing really looks like.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] You believe me? Nobody ever believes the mechanic.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] You talk far too much to keep a secret like that.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [angry] Then it was somebody quiet, somebody who plans ahead. I will find out who.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [sighs] You really think I would wreck a marble from my own garage?

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] You were the one standing there holding the wrench.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [angry] Every goblin in this sport owns a wrench, kid! That proves nothing!

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] I found the old mine, like you told me to. I came to ask Smokey's secret myself.

speaker: the-hood
text: [frustrated] You actually came down here. That was not supposed to happen.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Welcome to my mine, under the next track. This is where I plan my races.

speaker: the-hood
text: [firmly] I did not ask for anybody to come down here and watch.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] Wait, I know your face. You are in the old team photo in the Apex garage. You are—

speaker: the-hood
text: [quietly] I am the Apex Racing driver who disappeared last season. Yes, it is me.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] You are The Hood? You have been racing for Vex this whole time?

speaker: the-hood
text: [angry] I owed Vex a lot of money. Racing for her in secret is how I pay it back.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] Two Apex drivers in one room, and one very old contract. How lovely.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] I trained that driver too, years ago, in the same shed where I trained you.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] I rebuilt your marble with a new bolt and new parts. This time it will hold.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] It had better, because somebody cut through the last bolt with a saw.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [surprised] Vex has paid off the race officials. All of them. Try not to look so surprised.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] You once told me she keeps a file on every driver in the sport.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [angry] She has a file on me too. Now she wants to control the whole championship.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [cheerful] Our next track is Suzuka Spiral, which is full of spinning traps and splitters.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] If we work together there, we can beat her drivers. Alone, we both lose.

speaker: red-morrigan
text: [angry] Suzuka is full of spinners, so somebody is going to get flung off the track.

speaker: the-hood
text: [determined] I have always raced wherever Vex told me to. Today I race against her instead.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Then today, we race against her together.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] Drivers, stop the Apex marbles before the next section. That is an order.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [surprised] Take the left side, rookie! I will block the spinner on the right!

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [gasps] You won at Suzuka, using the racing line I showed you. Do not tell my sponsors.

speaker: the-hood
text: [relieved] Vex watched the whole race from her control room in the mine. She saw you win.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Good. I hope she looked at the scoreboard for a very long time.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] A top three finish, even with Vex working against you. That will annoy her.

speaker: the-hood
text: [quietly] Vex ordered me to take that place away from you. I could not do it.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Refusing her orders is the bravest thing I have seen anyone do today.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] One spinning trap hit me, and I lost three places just like that.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [angry] Vex's crew changed the race timing. You were never racing a fair clock.

speaker: the-hood
text: [determined] The final race is down in the mine. Bring everything you have left.

speaker: the-hood
text: [angry] These are Vex's plans. She controls every camera, light and explosive down here.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] The final track is Yas Marble, a night race, and part of it runs through my mine.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] You put dynamite on a race track? People could get hurt!

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] It is building work, darling. Scheduled building work, and perfectly legal.

speaker: the-hood
text: [determined] Her plan is to blow up the race if she is losing. We cannot let that happen.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Then we make sure every driver gets to the finish line safely. Down we go.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] I found explosives in two places on the track: section ten and section twenty-six.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] You went down into the mine by yourself to look?

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [angry] I am a mechanic, kid. Following wires is part of my job.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] It is a night race on the longest track of the season, and Vex controls the lights.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Nobody knows what Vex has hidden on this track, and that is the worst kind of danger.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Then I will find out what she has hidden while I am racing past it.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] You believed me after the crash at Spa, so look what I found for you.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [angry] This receipt shows Vex's crew bought the exact bolt that broke on your marble.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] So it was Vex all along. Now we have proof.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] This is the final track of the season, rookie. Try not to dent the trophy.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] Welcome to Yas Marble, everyone. Everything you can see here belongs to me.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Everything except the race. You cannot own who wins.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Watch out at sections ten and twenty-six, kid. Whatever happens, keep rolling.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [surprised] Here is the plan. I block Vex's drivers, and you race for the win.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] The champion is protecting the scrapyard goblin. I never thought I would see it.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [angry] Say that one more time, and I will start blocking you instead.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [sighs] So you are racing alone. Ten marbles, one rookie, and a mine full of dynamite.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Doing things alone is how we have always done it in the scrapyard.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] Crew, the rookie is coming. Get ready to stop that marble!

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [gasps] The explosives are just ahead! Stay on the left and keep rolling!

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [gasps] You won the final race, through a mine full of traps, on my racing line.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] The race officials are asking about my explosives. Who told them?

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Everyone told them. That is the problem with making so many enemies.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] A top three finish in the final race. Whatever the scoreboard says, that is real.

speaker: the-hood
text: [relieved] Vex did not get the result she paid for. That is a win for all of us.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] She still got most of what she wanted, though.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] The explosion at section twenty-six threw me off the track, and that was it.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [angry] Vex's crew was waiting right there on the left side with the explosives.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] But every driver reached the finish line safely, and that was our real plan.

speaker: the-hood
text: [determined] I tore up my contract with Vex. I have paid her back with every race I lost.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] Without my team, you are nothing. Nobody will hire you.

speaker: the-hood
text: [relieved] I am a driver who can show my face again. That is worth more than your team.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Apex Racing still has your old seat. It has been waiting for you all season.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [gasps] They are calling your name, kid! The scrapyard goblin is the new champion!

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] An iron trophy, a dented marble, and one bolt that finally held on.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] A marble made from scrap, standing on top of my podium. This is a disgrace.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] I lost the first championship ever raced. Today I get to watch my student win one.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] We went all the way down into that mine, and we came back up as winners.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] And look, kid, two drivers already want to join Apex Racing next season.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [cheerful] I came second in the championship, behind a scrapyard goblin. My sponsors will cry.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] I will make sure to tell them, very loudly, that you helped me.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] We race again next season, partner, and I will not be this nice twice.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [angry] The race officials found my plans for the mine. Somebody talked to them.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] Remember, child, my contracts last longer than any championship.

speaker: the-hood
text: [relieved] My debt to Vex is paid, and I raced that last race for myself, not for her.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Apex Racing still has your old seat, you know. It has been empty all season.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] My arm is still in a sling, so I watched the whole finale lying on a stretcher.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] I lost the very first championship, but I taught the goblin who won this one.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] I spent years hiding in that shed, and now my student is the champion.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Then we should put both of our names on the trophy.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [cheerful] Third place in the championship! You won a real trophy you can actually lift!

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] I was so close to winning. One better race would have done it.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] Top three is top three, rookie. Ask the drivers who finished at the bottom.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] You came out of that mine with a trophy. Most drivers come out with nothing.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Next season, I will either win the whole thing or go back to the scrapyard.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] And guess what, kid? Two new drivers already want to join Apex Racing.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [smug] I won the championship, and you made the top three. Everybody is happy, mostly me.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] I saw you blocking Vex's drivers for me down in the mine.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [surprised] You saw nothing, rookie. That was just an accident on the track.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [cheerful] Third place overall. I can still use a driver like that, and I have a pen ready.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] I remember your pen. It felt heavier than my marble.

speaker: the-hood
text: [quietly] Vex ordered me to take points from you this season, and I did it. I am sorry.

speaker: the-hood
text: [determined] Next season I race for nobody but myself, and for Apex, if they will have me.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] Third place, a broken arm and rain. My first season ended exactly the same way.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Then we will hang our two photos next to each other.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] Top three in your very first season. I missed out on that by a hair, back then.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] Next season, I am going to win the whole thing for both of us.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] No championship points, and my marble is in pieces inside a bag.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [sighs] I can build you a new marble, kid. I built my first one out of a washing machine.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Vex rigged the final race, and you still drove straight down into that mine.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] That bravery is what I will remember, not where you finished.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Then I will come back next season and do it all again.

speaker: zapp-gutwrench
text: [surprised] Two drivers have already asked to join Apex Racing next season, kid.

speaker: ace-spadegrin
text: [sighs] I blocked Vex's drivers as long as I could, but it was not enough. I am sorry.

speaker: sprocket
text: [smug] It was not your fault, Ace. She rigged a whole mine against us.

speaker: duchess-vex
text: [smug] You finished with no points, so you are of no use to me. How dull.

speaker: sprocket
text: [gasps] You cheated in the final race, and you still sound bored about it.

speaker: the-hood
text: [relieved] The race officials took Vex's equipment. You lost the race, but she lost more.

speaker: sprocket
text: [sighs] It still does not feel the same as winning.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [sighs] No points and a broken arm. My best season ended looking a lot like this.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [cheerful] But I still taught somebody worth teaching. Come back to the shed in spring.

speaker: old-smokey
text: [angry] Last place. Good, because now you owe nobody anything.

speaker: sprocket
text: [cheerful] Can I come back to your shed and train again in the spring?

speaker: old-smokey
text: [smug] You can, but come earlier this time. We have a lot of work to do.
